puns.text: My code has no bugs. It has undocumented features with strong personalities.
I tried to refactor my life, but the dependencies wouldn't resolve.
The database and I had a falling out. There was no common key between us.
I'd tell you a UDP joke, but you might not get it.
My legacy app asked for therapy. It had too many unresolved issues from the past.
Deduplicating customer records is rewarding. You really find out who people are.
I normalized my sleep schedule. Now it's in third normal form and I'm always tired.
Attribution modeling is hard. Every channel wants to take credit for my coffee.
I asked OAuth for a date. It said I needed consent first, which is fair.
My refresh token got rotated so often it started feeling dizzy.
My dog is a great developer. Every commit is a little ruff, but she always fetches the latest changes.
We walk the same route every day. My dog calls it a stable release.
I cycle aimlessly to clear my head. It's very wheel-being focused.
My bike can't stand up on its own. It's two tired.
Embroidery taught me patience. Every project has a lot of loose threads at first.
My embroidery hoop and I are close. We've been through a lot of tension together.
I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. I can't put it down.
I filed a 311 request for more puns. Status: pending, but the city says it's under review and over the moon.
